records.claim: Project Marinus marked the start of its next construction phase; Stage 1 provides a future 750 MW two-way interconnector.
records.observation: A financed and approved interconnector is moving into physical construction.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA in project stage; capacity is not yet operational.

records.claim: S&P Global counted 19 September LNG shipments through Hormuz and Kpler 21, up from 15 in June; dark transits persisted.
records.observation: LNG flow recovered materially while abnormal navigation and security conditions persisted.

records.source: G7 Leaders / Council of the EU
records.claim: G7 leaders committed to a coordinated 100 million barrel release through the IEA over four months, beginning immediately, with a substantial diesel release frontloaded within 20 days.
records.observation: The earlier diesel-stock proposal crossed into a collective policy commitment and implementation schedule.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA. Strategic stocks become an active buffer for the refined-products bottleneck.

records.claim: Gas Malaysia targets FID in H2 2027 for a Kedah LNG import terminal of up to 6 mtpa.
records.observation: Northern Malaysia is developing an alternative import route, but capital commitment has not reached FID.
